company.name: Jumbo Privacy
company.shortDescription: Jumbo Privacy is a B2C privacy and security app that protects users on iOS and Android.
company.description:
Jumbo Privacy offers a mobile application available on iOS and Android that helps users manage their online privacy and security.

At Jumbo, they believe that your data belongs to you. That’s why their app empowers users to take control of their privacy and security, right from their phones. Jumbo is an app that gives you back control of your data and privacy.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application available on iOS and Android that helps users protect their online privacy and security by giving control over privacy settings, notifying of data breaches, checking Wi-Fi security, and blocking trackers.
productsAndServices.name: Jumbo App

productsAndServices.description: Provides identity theft insurance coverage up to $1,000,000 in the US to help users restore their identity if stolen.
productsAndServices.name: Identity Theft Insurance

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows users to add their phone numbers to the FTC’s Do Not Call list to reduce telemarketing calls.
productsAndServices.name: Do Not Call List

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables users to blur their home on Google Street View to maintain privacy and security.
productsAndServices.name: Blur My Home

productsAndServices.description: A service that scans the dark web for users' personal information to alert them of potential data breaches.
productsAndServices.name: Dark Web Scan

productsAndServices.description: Allows users to archive old social media posts to reduce their digital footprint and manage their online presence.
productsAndServices.name: Social Media Archiving
